About Hokey Home Care

Hokey Home Care has been supplying Singapore homes with practical, well-made kitchen and household essentials since 2006 — from everyday gadgets to small appliances that hold up to daily use.

We keep things simple: straightforward pricing, no gimmicks, and products we'd actually use ourselves.

Good to Know

Straightforward, same as everything else we do.

Privacy Policy

We collect the details you give us at checkout — name, email, phone, and delivery address — only to process and deliver your order. We don't sell your data. Payment is made directly to our bank account via PayNow, so we never see or store your card or bank login details.

Under Singapore's PDPA, you can ask us to access or correct your personal data anytime — email sales@hokey.com.sg or WhatsApp +65 9116 3266.

Starting-point policy — have it reviewed before publishing, to confirm it matches exactly how the business handles data.

Returns & Refunds

Damaged, defective, or wrong item? Email us within 3 days of delivery with your order details and a photo, and we'll sort a replacement, repair, or refund.

Change-of-mind returns are accepted within 3 days for unused items in original packaging; return shipping is on you unless the item was faulty.

Starting-point policy — confirm the exact timeframes and conditions before publishing.
